title: Intel Introduces First Pentium II Processors for Mobile PCs
scope_note: Introduces first mobile Pentium II processors at 233 and 266 MHz; states mobile PC availability beginning today and component/module pricing.

title: Intel Microprocessor Quick Reference Guide - Year
scope_note: Historical first-party chronology lists 1998 introduction dates for mobile Pentium II 300, 266, and 233 MHz; accessed lines around 981-1020.

title: Intel Microprocessor Quick Reference Guide - Product Family
scope_note: Historical first-party family table identifies mobile Pentium II 300 MHz with Sept. 9, 1998 intro and mobile 266/233 with Apr. 2, 1998 intro; identifies mobile PC typical use.

title: Intel Readies Industry To Deliver Next-Generation, Power-Efficient Mobile Computing Platforms
scope_note: Contemporary Intel release calls the mobile Pentium II 300 MHz recently introduced and describes mobile-market power characteristics, but does not give an exact launch day.

title: Intel Introduces Pentium II OverDrive Processor For Pentium Pro Processor-Based Systems
scope_note: Introduces the Pentium II OverDrive upgrade processor; maps 300/333 MHz outputs to supported Pentium Pro systems and states second-half-August reseller/distributor availability.

title: AMD Achieves Record Sales and Bookings as It Returns to Profitability
scope_note: Filed AMD exhibit reproduces an October 6, 1998 press release; states that during Q3 AMD introduced a 300MHz AMD-K6 processor for mobile applications. Exact day and channel are not stated.
